title: {child} and the Magical Cricket Bat
synopsis: A kind choice leads {child} onto a moonlit cricket pitch, where helping a new friend creates the brightest magic of all.
lesson: Kindness, and helping a new friend feel welcome.
pages: After school, {child} placed the cricket bat by the balcony and told Nani about the day: a friend's missing notebook found, and the winning run in the evening game.
That night, a soft golden glow slipped from the cricket bat. It hummed a tiny tune, as if it wanted to share a secret.
The bat floated to the window and pointed at the moon. Below it, a moonlit cricket pitch appeared, where a shy new friend stood all alone.
{child} remembered how good it felt to help. So {child} passed the bat to the new friend and cheered for every swing, big or small.
The two friends laughed until the stars blinked sleepily. The brightest magic of all, {child} thought, is the magic of being kind.
